name: DocumentProperty
description: Represents a custom or built-in document property of a container document. The DocumentProperty object is a member of the DocumentProperties collection.
remarks: Use the Microsoft Word Document.BuiltinDocumentProperties(_index_) property, where _index_ is the name or index number of the built-in document property, to return a single DocumentProperty object that represents a specific built-in document property. Use the Word Document.CustomDocumentProperties(_index_) property, where _index_ is the name or index number of the custom document property, to return a DocumentProperty object that represents a specific custom document property.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the DocumentProperty object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of a document property. Read/write.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of a document property. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets the document property type. Read-only for built-in document properties; read/write for custom document properties.

properties.name: LinkToContent
properties.description: Is True if the value of the custom document property is linked to the content of the container document. False if the value is static. Read/write.

properties.name: LinkSource
properties.description: Gets or sets the source of a linked custom document property. Read/write.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the DocumentProperty object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the DocumentProperty object was created. Read-only.
